theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_sp_cayley_equivalence
theorems.statement: (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < 1 → 0 < (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w)).im) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → ‖(z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)‖ < 1) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Complex.I * (1 + (z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)) / (1 - (z - Complex.I) / (z + Complex.I)) = z) ∧ (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w‖ < 1 → (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) - Complex.I) / (Complex.I * (1 + w) / (1 - w) + Complex.I) = w)
theorems.natural_summary: Prove denominator nonvanishing on each domain. Expanding the imaginary part gives Im φ(w) = (1 − ‖w‖²)/‖1 − w‖² > 0. The squared-norm difference ‖z+i‖² − ‖z−i‖² = 4 Im z > 0 proves ‖ψ(z)‖ < 1. Clearing the proven nonzero denominators establishes both inverse identities.
